verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is thin. The AI Assistant docs say it can 'analyze performance' (unity-docs-24), and a community comment implies Unity's profiling is well ahead of Godot's (unity-comm-9). Nothing documents a dedicated profiler tool or any data-oriented scaling path; the generic 'scalable visuals' and 'optimize' marketing lines do not cover ECS, jobs or instancing. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the Profiler, any evidence of ECS/DOTS, the C# Job System or Burst, GPU instancing documentation, and hands-on corroboration of scaling heavy scenes.
